title: Home loan required documents
content: For a demo home-loan application, applicants provide identity proof, address proof, proof of income, six months of bank statements, and property-related documents. Rules vary by lender; this is synthetic training content.

title: KYC onboarding verification
content: This demo KYC workflow verifies identity proof, address proof, document validity, and customer identity. Escalate mismatches for human review. These are synthetic training instructions.

title: Personal loan repayment and EMI
content: Loan EMI depends on principal, annual interest rate, and repayment period. For a fixed-rate amortizing loan, use the standard EMI formula. No loan approval decision is made by this demo.

title: Credit card application and approval
content: For a demo credit card application, applicants provide identity proof, address proof, and income verification.
